tesseb.scope: All rows of published TESS EB catalog Prsa et al. 2022, sectors 1-26. Membership established by being in this EB table, not by links in live website. Not a complete current live catalog.

published_candidates.scope: Published vetted candidates only; no complete all-sector/all-TCE claim.

derived_sources.limitations: Cached catalog matching only. Nonmatch is not novelty. Sky positions are not propagated for proper motion; a 30 arcsec match may identify a contaminant, not the target. Harmonics are ranking flags, not signal identifications. Per-target literature, aliases, TCE/DV and pixel checks remain required.

snapshots.query: select g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.bp_rp,g.ruwe,g.non_single_star,g.phot_variable_flag,v.in_vari_eclipsing_binary from gaiadr3.gaia_source g left outer join gaiadr3.vari_summary v on g.source_id=v.source_id where 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',116.921919276117,-68.6214072142848,0.0333333333333333))
select id from ident where oidref=7666111
select r.bibcode,r.doi,r.title,r.abstract from has_ref h join ref r on h.oidbibref=r.oidbib where h.oidref=7666111
